purpose: Independent sidebar local Release resource evidence; all retained numeric samples, no raw AX or log bodies.

units.CPU: 100% equals one fully occupied logical CPU

aggregation: Median of three footprint captures per fresh run, then median and min/max of three fresh run medians. Role medians and the tool total are separate metrics and need not add up. RSS is a separate sum, not footprint.
comparisonLimits: Observed public 0.1 controls and observed 0.2 cohorts are the primary comparison. Original no-CUA baseline is retained as context, not an isolated sidebar-cost control.
An AX observer effect is plausible, not established or quantified on this host. Files adds native chooser AX operations and additional pre-gate time.
CUA exact-path binding automatic versus explicit initial AX, active-window appearance, renderer changes, app version and build/signing state are not allocation-isolated.
Three runs per condition, ranges overlap, sequential cohorts and warm OS caches; no causal or statistical significance claim.
The benchmark has 1,484 heading lines and optional renderers. Its difference from prose cannot isolate math/Mermaid cost.
Raw v2 control latencyLimit/protocol text saying before readiness is superseded: timestamps may precede, overlap or follow UI observation. Raw files are immutable.
Public 0.1 events have no timing label and remain unreported. Source-era two-frame behavior does not turn unlabeled events into confirmed frame samples.
Launch latency is initial requested-mode latency with no selected root, never Files latency with an already-selected folder.
Timer fallback establishes progress, not painted pixels. Timing groups are never mixed. Empty display latency is not applicable.
Visible pane 230pt requires native divider position 238 on this host. Content 900x700 is source-derived; observed outer frame is 900x784.

protocol.purpose: Independent matched baseline for the Files and Outline sidebar comparison.
protocol.sourceSHAEvidence: Matched the installed executable to the public release manifest.
protocol.ordering: Rotate the first case by one on each repeat; use a fresh app process for every run.
protocol.latency: Collect body and complete unified-log events for the new exact-app PID. Record native ms from document-open request and wall-clock ms from process-launch request. Empty has no document display event; body/complete are not applicable.
protocol.memory: After complete (or new-app PID establishment for empty), wait 15 seconds, then take three raw footprint captures 0.5 seconds apart. Report process footprint and RSS separately.
protocol.ownership: Snapshot existing Leaflit/WebKit PIDs before launch; identify exactly one new PID at the exact installed executable path first. Query the Darwin function responsibility_get_pid_responsible_for_pid for each candidate helper. Include only new helper PIDs whose responsible PID equals the newly established app PID. Exclude unrelated and unresolved helpers; record unresolved responsibility as ambiguity. After terminating the owned app, verify every included helper exits too.
protocol.ownershipLimit: The narrower responsibility function is available without elevation on this host. Its availability is host-specific and is validated by the observed app and helper responsible PIDs. launchctl procinfo requires root and was not used.
protocol.cleanup: SIGTERM only the newly identified exact-path app PID; wait for attributed helpers to exit. Do not close or activate existing windows, alter preferences, install, sign, or publish.
protocol.cache: OS caches remain warm; no cache flush or memory purge.

protocol.observerCondition: CUA exact-app binding (automatic AX) plus one full AX/screenshot readiness capture; Files additionally requires native chooser observations. No further app observations during settling/sampling.
protocol.ownership: Establish the exact new app PID first; include only new WebKit helper PIDs whose Darwin responsiblePID equals that app PID. Recheck ownership at every sample. Exclude unknown/unrelated helpers and mark incomplete attribution separately.
protocol.initialLaunchState: Public 0.1.0 has no sidebar and receives no sidebar launch arguments.
protocol.geometry: Keep the fresh native window size unchanged. Record actual observed outer bounds separately from optional observed content bounds. Initial 900x700 content size is derived from source, not an observation; never enter it as measured CUA bounds.
protocol.latency: Body/complete are the original fixture-launch events, before native folder choice and the ready gate. Both wall-clock launch ms and native document-open ms are retained. The log stream is asynchronous and never blocks the UI gate; a phase can arrive during or after observation. Retain its original timestamp. Missing events remain missing with cause unconfirmed, independently of memory coverage. Empty is N/A.
protocol.memory: After actual UI verification (and native folder choice for Files), wait 15 seconds, take three footprint captures 0.5 seconds apart, and report app, owned helpers and RSS separately.
protocol.ordering: For each fresh repeat rotate cohort order and case order by one; no cache flush.
protocol.cleanup: SIGTERM only the new exact-path app PID with unchanged start token. Never terminate pre-existing apps or helpers; wait for attributed helpers to exit.
protocol.ui: Only human/CUA input may configure or inspect the new app. No AppleScript, responder call, product test API, broad folder scan or preference write is performed by this tool.
protocol.preferenceLimit: The app itself may persist native layout changes. Report before/after keys; do not blindly restore a whole preference domain over user state.
